purpose: Export Structure work primarily as CanonicalWireframe (CW) and optionally as presentation-only vector images without allowing visual output to become semantic authority.
invariants: CW is the primary and preferred Structure export format.
CW export preserves explicit semantic identities, relations, hierarchy, properties, provenance and other fields defined by the CW format contract.
SVG is a derived visual export of an explicit projection or Scene and is never semantic authority.
SVG export MUST NOT invent nodes, relations, hierarchy, labels or meaning that are absent from the selected projection/Scene.
Projection style, layout, camera, colors, node size, visibility and other presentation state MAY affect SVG output but MUST NOT alter CW semantics.
Hidden or filtered content is omitted from an SVG only as a presentation choice; omission MUST NOT mutate the underlying CW or input structure.
A 3D Scene exported to SVG is flattened through the explicitly selected camera/view state into a 2D vector representation.
Every export write MUST satisfy Structure_Input_Output_Isolation_Contract_v1.2 before the first target mutation.
Exporter never writes to any input scope.
There is no conversion from SVG back into accepted CW semantics without a separate explicit detector/mapping process.

requirements: Conform to the active CW Format Contract.
Preserve semantic identity and explicit provenance.
Do not include viewer-only state unless the CW Format Contract explicitly defines a non-semantic presentation section.
Use vector primitives for nodes, connections and text where representable.
Preserve the selected projection composition and visible labels.
Include a metadata block identifying Structure, source input ids, projection instance ids and projection settings when available.
Metadata is provenance/presentation metadata only and does not make SVG a CW document.
For 3D projection export, use the current explicit camera/view transform to produce the 2D SVG coordinates.

selection.cw: Export an explicitly selected CW workspace/model.
selection.svg: Export one selected projection instance, a selected group of projection instances, or the current Scene composition.
selection.rule: Exporter MUST make the exported scope explicit before writing.

ui.rule: CW appears first and is the default export action.

future_formats.rule: Additional formats may be added only as explicit exporter adapters. They do not change CW primacy or semantic authority.
